purpose.summary: This program (ORCR0040) is part of the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt (claim) software system. It handles editing and automatic generation of comments on medical receipt (Rezept) records, processing receipt detail files (RECE02, RECE04, RECE05 and their work/output variants) to insert or update comment entries based on treatment type, rehabilitation, drug adjustments, and other clinical billing rules.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance claims)

notable_features: Multiple indexed file selects with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes
Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Large program: ~6700 lines, 577 PERFORM statements, 20 CALL statements
Revision history spanning 2002–2009 with named maintainers
Work file variants (RECE049, RECE059) alongside primary files
verdict.notes: The file is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but was decoded as latin-1, causing the Japanese characters to appear as mojibake in the comments. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source ORCA medical receipt system maintained by JMA (Japan Medical Association). The COPY statements reference .INC copybooks that were not expanded in the truncated view, but the structure is unambiguously production COBOL.
